name: Aura Chat Button
author: Aura Plugin

sections.description:
Aura Chat Button for WordPress & WooCommerce

Add a professional WhatsApp chat button to your website. Aura Chat Button is a high-performance WhatsApp widget designed to boost customer engagement and sales through seamless click to chat WhatsApp integration.

Manage your customer support efficiently with the WhatsApp business hours scheduler that ensures you only receive chats when your team is available. Experience the most advanced WhatsApp analytics plugin for WordPress, tracking every click, open, and conversion to optimize your sales funnel.

Boost your conversion rates with our premium WhatsApp chat button designed specifically for WooCommerce product pages and high-traffic landing pages. Our responsive WhatsApp button offers 4 unique 3D styles and mobile-first settings, providing a seamless user experience across all devices. Improve support speed with automatic page title and URL sharing, so you know exactly which product your customers are asking about on WhatsApp.

Why Choose Aura Chat Button?

  • WooCommerce Smart Integration – Pre-configured for Shop, Cart, and Product pages.
  • Premium 3D Button Styles – 4 professional designs with high-end glassmorphism and 3D effects.
  • Advanced Analytics Dashboard – Track clicks, chat opens, conversions, and conversion rates.
  • Contextual Support – Automatically includes page title (H1) and URL in WhatsApp messages.
  • Business Hours Scheduler – Control visibility based on your working schedule.
  • Typewriter Greeting – Interactive “Support Team is typing…” animation for higher engagement.
  • Mobile First Design – Separate positioning and size controls for mobile devices.

Key Features

  • WooCommerce Mastery – Specific controls for Shop, Products, Cart, Checkout, and Account pages.
  • 4 Stunning Button Styles – Elegant Round, Embossed 3D, Modern Square, and Deluxe Square.
  • Dynamic Analytics – Real-time statistics with Chart.js integration.
  • Multi-Language Support – Fully translated into 10 major global languages.
  • Working Hours Scheduling – Set available days/times with custom offline notifications.
  • Pixel-Perfect UI – Fine-tune position (X/Y) separately for desktop and mobile.
  • Typewriter Effect – High-conversion greeting messages with typing simulation.
  • URL Sanitization – Intelligent protocol stripping to prevent WhatsApp link preview issues.
  • Custom Avatar Support – Brand your chat widget with your own logo or support agent photo.

10 Languages Supported

  • English (default)
  • Turkish (tr_TR) – 🇹🇷
  • German (de_DE) – 🇩🇪
  • Spanish (es_ES) – 🇪🇸
  • French (fr_FR) – 🇫🇷
  • Italian (it_IT) – 🇮🇹
  • Japanese (ja) – 🇯🇵
  • Portuguese (PT-BR) – 🇧🇷
  • Russian (ru_RU) – 🇷🇺
  • Chinese (zh_CN) – 🇨🇳
  • Hindi (hi_IN) – 🇮🇳
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aura-chat-button folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the ‘Aura Chat Button’ menu in your admin dashboard.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp phone number with country code.
  5. Customize the appearance and enable WooCommerce/Scheduling if needed.
sections.faq:
Is this compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes! We have a dedicated WooCommerce tab where you can enable/disable the button on specific store pages.

How does the analytics work?

The plugin tracks when users click the button, when the chat window opens, and when they actually click to send the message to WhatsApp.

Can I hide the button on mobile?

Yes, you have full control over mobile visibility and can also hide the label while keeping the button.

Does it support RTL languages?

Yes, the design is fully RTL compatible.
